<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Sergilene Lima | Gerontoterapeuta</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Gerontoterapia Positiva Integrada (GPI®) para mulheres 40+ em Natal/RN. Acompanhamento com afeto para você florescer na maturidade." />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --teal:       #2BABB4;
      --teal-light: #3dc8d2;
      --teal-pale:  #e8f7f8;
      --green:      #8DC63F;
      --dark:       #083a3e;
      --dark-80:    rgba(8,58,62,0.82);
      --white:      #ffffff;
      --off-white:  #f7fafa;
      --gray:       #5a6e6f;
      --gray-light: #dce8e8;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      color: var(--dark);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ── NAV ── */
    nav {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 18px 5%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-light);
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--dark);
      text-decoration: none;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: var(--teal); display: block; font-size: 0.72rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
    .nav-links a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--gray); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color .2s; }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }
    .btn-nav {
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-nav:hover { background: var(--dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* hamburger */
    .hamburger { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; padding: 4px; }
    .hamburger span { width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--dark); border-radius: 2px; transition: .3s; }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 100px 5% 60px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--off-white) 0%, var(--teal-pale) 100%);
      gap: 60px;
    }
    .hero-text { max-width: 560px; }
    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      line-height: 1.18;
      color: var(--dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero h1 em { color: var(--teal); font-style: italic; }
    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--gray);
      margin-bottom: 32px; max-width: 480px;
    }
    .btn-group { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn-secondary {
      border: 2px solid var(--teal); color: var(--teal);
      padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none; transition: .2s;
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--teal); color: var(--white); }

    .hero-badges {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }
    .badge {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--gray);
    }
    .badge::before {
      content: '✦'; color: var(--green); font-size: 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .hero-visual {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 48px 36px;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(8,58,62,0.12);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      max-width: 340px;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .hero-card-icon {
      width: 80px; height: 80px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-pale), var(--teal-pale));
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      font-size: 2rem;
    }
    .hero-card h3 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .hero-card p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--gray); margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .method-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      padding: 6px 18px; border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }
    .floating-badge {
      position: absolute; top: -16px; right: -16px;
      background: var(--green); color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%; width: 72px; height: 72px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.7rem; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(141,198,63,0.4);
    }

    /* ── SECTIONS SHARED ── */
    section { padding: 90px 5%; }
    .section-label {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .section-label::before {
      content: ''; width: 28px; height: 2px; background: var(--teal); border-radius: 2px;
    }
    h2 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
      color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.22; margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .lead { font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--gray); max-width: 580px; }

    /* ── SOBRE ── */
    #sobre {
      background: var(--white);
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 70px; align-items: center;
    }
    .sobre-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--teal-pale), #d4edef);
      border-radius: 24px; padding: 50px 36px;
      text-align: center; position: relative;
    }
    .sobre-initials {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 5rem; color: var(--teal); opacity: 0.15;
      position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 24px;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .sobre-quote {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.15rem; font-style: italic;
      color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .sobre-quote::before { content: '"'; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--teal); line-height: 0; vertical-align: -0.6em; margin-right: 6px; }
    .sobre-assinatura {
      font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--gray); font-weight: 500;
    }
    .sobre-text p { color: var(--gray); margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .credenciais {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .credencial {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: var(--teal-pale); border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--dark);
    }
    .credencial-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }

    /* ── METODOLOGIA ── */
    #metodologia {
      background: var(--dark);
      color: var(--white);
    }
    #metodologia .section-label { color: var(--green); }
    #metodologia .section-label::before { background: var(--green); }
    #metodologia h2 { color: var(--white); }
    #metodologia .lead { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

    .pilares-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px; margin-top: 52px;
    }
    .pilar {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: background .25s, transform .2s;
    }
    .pilar:hover { background: rgba(43,171,180,0.15); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .pilar-icon { font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .pilar h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .pilar p { font-size: 0.83rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.55; }

    /* ── SERVIÇOS ── */
    #servicos { background: var(--off-white); }
    .servicos-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px; margin-top: 52px;
    }
    .servico-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 32px 28px;
      border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s, transform .2s;
    }
    .servico-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(43,171,180,0.12);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .servico-icon {
      width: 52px; height: 52px;
      background: var(--teal-pale);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .servico-card h3 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .servico-card p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── DIFERENCIAIS ── */
    #diferenciais { background: var(--white); }
    .dif-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px; align-items: center; margin-top: 52px;
    }
    .dif-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
    .dif-item {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-light);
      transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
    }
    .dif-item:hover { border-color: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(43,171,180,0.08); }
    .dif-num {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--teal); opacity: 0.3;
      line-height: 1; flex-shrink: 0; width: 32px;
    }
    .dif-content h4 { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .dif-content p { font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--gray); }

    .dif-highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--dark), #0d5560);
      border-radius: 24px; padding: 48px 36px;
      text-align: center; color: var(--white);
    }
    .dif-highlight .big {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 3.5rem; color: var(--teal-light); line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .dif-highlight .label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 32px; }
    .dif-highlight blockquote {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.1rem; font-style: italic;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* ── JORNADA ── */
    #jornada { background: var(--teal-pale); }
    .jornada-steps {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0; margin-top: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .jornada-steps::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; top: 36px; left: 8%; right: 8%;
      height: 2px; background: var(--teal); opacity: 0.25;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .step {
      text-align: center; padding: 0 16px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .step-num {
      width: 72px; height: 72px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--teal);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 18px;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--teal);
    }
    .step h4 { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .step p { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* ── PALESTRANTE ── */
    #palestrante { background: var(--white); }
    .palestras-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px; margin-top: 52px;
    }
    .palestra-card {
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px 26px;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--green);
      transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s;
    }
    .palestra-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(8,58,62,0.08); }
    .palestra-card h4 {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1rem; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .palestra-card p { font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--gray); }
    .palestra-card .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(141,198,63,0.15); color: #4a7a1a;
      padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    /* ── CONTATO ── */
    #contato {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--dark) 0%, #0a4a50 100%);
      color: var(--white); text-align: center;
    }
    #contato h2 { color: var(--white); }
    #contato .lead { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin: 0 auto 40px; }
    #contato .section-label { justify-content: center; color: var(--green); }
    #contato .section-label::before { background: var(--green); }
    .contato-btns { display: flex; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 56px; }
    .btn-wpp {
      background: #25d366; color: var(--white);
      padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      transition: .2s;
    }
    .btn-wpp:hover { background: #1da851; transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn-insta {
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      transition: .2s;
    }
    .btn-insta:hover { border-color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .contato-info {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 48px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding-top: 40px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .info-item { text-align: center; }
    .info-item .info-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .info-item .info-val { font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    footer {
      background: var(--dark);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      padding: 28px 5%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px;
    }
    .footer-logo {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }
    .footer-logo span { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--teal); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 0.78rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
    .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; }
    .footer-links a { font-size: 0.78rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── WHATSAPP FAB ── */
    .wpp-fab {
      position: fixed; bottom: 28px; right: 28px; z-index: 200;
      width: 58px; height: 58px;
      background: #25d366;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(37,211,102,0.45);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s;
    }
    .wpp-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(37,211,102,0.55); }
    .wpp-fab svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: white; }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .palestrante-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-top: 90px; text-align: center; }
      .hero p { margin: 0 auto 32px; }
      .btn-group { justify-content: center; }
      .hero-badges { align-items: center; }
      .hero-visual { order: -1; }
      .hero-card { max-width: 280px; }
      #sobre { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .pilares-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .servicos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .dif-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .jornada-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 28px; }
      .jornada-steps::before { display: none; }
      .palestras-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 560px) {
      section { padding: 64px 5%; }
      .pilares-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .jornada-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .contato-info { gap: 28px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <a href="#" class="nav-logo">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Sergilene Lima GPI® Gerontoterapeuta" style="height:52px;width:auto;">
  </a>
  <div class="nav-links">
    <a href="#sobre">Sobre</a>
    <a href="#metodologia">Metodologia</a>
    <a href="#servicos">Serviços</a>
    <a href="#palestrante">Palestras</a>
    <a href="#contato">Contato</a>
    <a href="https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=558496096533&text=Olá%2C%20Sergilene!%20Gostaria%20de%20saber%20mais%20sobre%20a%20Gerontoterapia." class="btn-nav" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Agendar Conversa</a>
  </div>
  <button class="hamburger" onclick="this.classList.toggle('open')" aria-label="Menu">
    <span></span><span></span><span></span>
  </button>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-text">
    <span class="eyebrow">Gerontoterapia Positiva Integrada · GPI®</span>
    <h1>Floresça na <em>maturidade</em> que é sua</h1>
    <p>Acompanhamento especializado para mulheres 40+ que desejam se reorganizar, descobrir forças e viver a melhor versão de si mesmas.</p>
